actual: LocalSIM unattended daily roll-forward creates a new runtime release by copying the source release runtime profile, daily strategy profile, execution policy, tail policy, validation state, and release policy JSON. A historical source can therefore carry retired V25 execution/model/tail authority into a new trade date, while the LocalSIM planner later forces TWAP-only. The persisted release and the executed policy become two authorities, and execution-algorithm retirement is not enforced at the roll-forward boundary. Fix only the LocalSIM roll-forward path so the new immutable release contains the canonical TWAP-only execution authority and no retired V25 execution/model/tail authority. Preserve MiniQMT roll-forward, package/manifest identity, strategy selection, capital, account, position, and order semantics. Fail closed when canonical authority cannot be formed; do not add a fallback or process control. Add direct LocalSIM/MiniQMT separation, retired-source, idempotency, and no-dual-authority tests.
